title: Smooth Gear Changes
summary: Feedback in this topic mainly mentions smooth automatic gear changes, while many other fragments use the word "changes" for model or software updates rather than transmission behavior.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise smooth, quiet automatic gear changes and say the updates make the car enjoyable to drive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention changes to the model, software, or general preferences, and one fragment references inconsistent shift behavior without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: This cluster mixes transmission smoothness with unrelated mentions of design, software, and general model changes.
Several undetermined fragments are too brief or ambiguous to support a clearer sentiment classification.
The examples are a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of all reviews on this topic.
